懸掛鼓一詞於2007年出現於美國鋼鼓製造商網站，原指其推出、作為2000年問世之: The term “hang drum” appeared in 2007 on the website of an American steel-drum maker, referring to the instrument that firm launched as a substitute for the Hang, which had come out in 2000; the name Hang is patented. After a follow-up forum was set up in 2009 the term became a general name for instruments of this kind, makers multiplied around the world, and instruments came to differ in material, process, the shape of the note areas and tuning. In 2025 the Swiss Federal Supreme Court upheld the first-instance ruling of the Commercial Court of the Canton of Bern that the Hang is a work of applied art and so protected by copyright; in 2026 that court found 210 of the 260 models submitted to infringe, and only those showing a marked difference — a top dome reworked into concave note areas or into triangular note areas, for instance — did not infringe.
懸掛鼓主體採用優質鋼材製造，凹陷音盤經特殊熱處理工藝形成，具有良好的共鳴與持久性: The body of the Rav Vast is made of good-quality steel, and the dished note field is formed by a special heat treatment that gives good resonance and lasting. The frame is steel as well, for durability and stability. The instrument hangs from a high-strength rope or a metal hook that holds it securely. The mallets used to play it usually have a wooden handle and a head of rubber or some soft material, which gives a warm, gentle tone.
懸掛鼓是一種源自德國的現代打擊樂器，由鋼製凹陷音盤組成，透過懸掛方式固定。演奏者: The Rav Vast is a modern percussion instrument with German origins, made of a dished steel note field and held by hanging. The player strikes different points with mallets or the fingers to bring out different pitches. Its timbre is deep and mysterious, joining the metallic quality of the steel drum to the resonance of the timpani; the bass is full and round, the middle and upper notes warm and soft. The instrument has rich natural overtones and a long resonance, and suits new-age music, yoga, meditation and therapeutic music in particular; it is often used for relaxation, healing and meditation.
懸掛鼓音色深邃神秘，具有獨特的冥想質感。其音域寬廣，低音渾厚飽滿，中高音則帶有金: The Rav Vast's timbre is deep and mysterious, with a distinctly meditative quality. Its range is wide: the bass is full and round, while the middle and upper notes have a warm metallic sheen. Striking different points changes the pitch, and the sound runs from a low drum boom to a clear metallic note. The cavity inside the instrument gives rich natural overtones, so the sound has depth and layers and a long ringing tail. Compared with traditional percussion the Rav Vast is gentler and softer, joining the metallic quality of the steel drum to the resonance of the timpani, and it conjures a calm, far-reaching atmosphere; it is often used in relaxation, healing and meditation music.
手持樂器，以敲擊方式發聲。手持樂器本體，透過敲擊、搖晃、刮奏或撥彈等方式使樂器本: This is a hand-held instrument, and it sounds when struck. Hold the body of the instrument and set it vibrating by striking, shaking, scraping or plucking. Different parts and different amounts of force give different timbres. In practice, first settle the correct holding position, and only once the basic way of sounding it is secure work on rhythm patterns and melody. Pluck the string with a fingertip or a pick, and watch the angle and force of the attack.
